exposure: low Lupus Low Disease Activity State (LLDAS) achievement rate
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Pregnant women with systemic lupus erythematosus and age-matched controls
finding: Pregnant women with systemic lupus erythematosus have a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including stillbirth, preeclampsia, preterm delivery, intrauterine growth retardation, admission to neonatal intensive care unit, and emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women with systemic lupus erythematosus had a higher rate of emergency cesarean section compared to the control group.
